title: Lavington, NSW - Infrastructure Restoration
current_summary: Services in Lavington, NSW were impacted by an unplanned access network issue caused by a power outage. Services were restored at approximately 3:15 PM AEST on 14 July 2026. If your service has not reconnected, please restart your modem/router and any network connection box, then test again. We are monitoring and no further impact is expected.

updates.content: Services in Lavington, NSW have been restored following a power issue affecting access network equipment. Most customers should now be back online. If your service hasn’t reconnected, please power-cycle your modem/router and any network connection box, then wait a few minutes before testing again. We’ll continue to monitor and we’re here to help if you need support.
